items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Well, there's another Happy too, the Matthews. Yeah, Remus. Remus Matthew.

ctx.x: He was a good drummer too, Red Hat. He didn't know he found him at Red Hat. I was right on after he was young. And so, ultimately, make the difference in the habit, they call him Red Hat. And they started to call me Black Happy. That's the reason the people for me, Black Happy today.
Well, there's another Happy too, the Matthews. Yeah, Remus. Remus Matthew.
They just called him Happy, huh? Yeah, always did call him Happy.
